# Wordnik Developer

> Developer platform providing RESTful API access to comprehensive dictionary data from American Heritage Dictionary, Century Dictionary, Wiktionary, WordNet, and more.

Wordnik offers a robust language API with word definitions, synonyms, antonyms, pronunciations, and usage examples. The platform provides Swagger-documented endpoints and client libraries for multiple programming languages, enabling developers to integrate rich dictionary functionality into their applications.

## Key Topics

- Wordnik API
- RESTful API
- Word definitions
- American Heritage Dictionary of the English Language
- Century Dictionary
- Wiktionary
- WordNet
- Swagger documentation
- Client libraries and SDKs
- Synonyms and antonyms
- Pronunciations
- Language data
- Developer tools
- Open-source libraries

## API Documentation

- [Wordnik for Developers](https://developer.wordnik.com/): Developer hub for Wordnik API with RESTful access to word definitions

## Client Libraries & SDKs

- [Wordnik Developer Libraries](https://developer.wordnik.com/libraries): Client libraries and SDKs for Wordnik API including Swagger support
